messages:
Priya: quick sync 9: proposal for a per-route protocol policy + lightweight proto->json linter.
Priya: idea: route config `protocol_policy: { prefer: \"grpc\", fallback: \"json\", allow_transcode: true }` and a console badge.
Ben: exportable via infra-as-code pls. we don't want hidden console-only state.
Marta: linter would have saved us from the gRPC-web 415 last week. +1 for CI gate.
Chris: perf note: transcode adds ~2-4ms p95 and an allocation. fine for most routes but gate on tight-tail APIs.
Priya: linter sample:
ERROR /v1/generate: response.choices proto=repeated, json=object -> severity=high
Hint: map to array or change proto type
Priya: run locally: `tools/protolint check ./proto --routes routes.yaml --out=diag.json`
devops-bot: deploy:protolint-canary queued (canary=3 nodes) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ben: telemetry: `protocol_used`, `protocol_fallback_count`, `transcode_latency_p95`, `proto_mismatch_lint_count` (tenant & route dims).
Chris: keep high-cardinality dims ephemeral. aggregate to route buckets for long retention.
Marta: Console UX: route list shows \"grpc (json fallback)\" badge, diagnostics card with lint messages and a diff/preview button.
Ben: quick-fix action: generate suggested json mapping + preview payload. big win for support.
Priya: rollout: feature-flag `route_protocol_policy_v1` -> 5% tenants -> 25% -> 100%. monitor `protocol_fallback_count` spike alert.
Chris: add canary alert if fallback_count > 3x baseline during rollout window.
Marta: tests: unit linter rules + infra/protocol-e2e against real shims (gRPC-web + envoy transcode) + CI smoke job.
Ben: SDKs: browser SDK default JSON, opt-in gRPC-web; server SDKs prefer gRPC. update quickstarts.
Priya: I'll draft RFC and minimal Go protolint prototype. pinging reviewers when posted.
Marta: I'll mock Console badge + diagnostics card and drop in #design.
Ben: will update CI gates and infra harness.
Chris: I'll make a short telemetry dashboard mock and alert runbook.
Priya: thanks everyone 9: will post RFC link shortly.
